source: Missing LangString compiler and Tauri delivery trace
detail: Default Tauri bundle verbosity 0 maps to bundler Error -> makensis -V1 -> display_warnings=false (absent later override); compiler records/notifies warning but does not print it inline or in summary. Tauri -v maps Info/-V3; -vv+ maps Trace/-V4. Emitted child stdout/stderr are duplicated directly by CommandExt::piped, not filtered through the debug logger. Direct makensis constructor defaults to verbosity 3; -V0/-V1 or !verbose can suppress warning output. Diagnostic policy can separately disable or promote warning 6040; promotion (for example -WX or a per-code warning pragma) quits with the fixed error, and warninghelper uses display_errors for visibility. No compiler/native UI executed. Source proof also establishes zero/empty substitution if compilation continues; no corrected-name fallback. Direct compiler default verbosity3 is distinct from default Tauri bundler settings verbosity0/-V1. Not an executed compiler acceptance test.
